title: Listen: Ruf Dug pops in for a live session on Colpey Calling x The Fix
content:
28th September 2015

This week we welcomed Ruf Dug, who nipped into our pop-up studio for a special live session. Having released the superb album Island just a couple of months ago, we were so excited to have him on. Let’s just say he didn’t disappoint, with a set including Moodymann, Omar-S and Al Dobson Jr. Check it out.

Tracklist

Colpey Calling

  • Ruf Dug – ‘Mangrove Dub’
  • Double Knots – ‘Double Vision’
  • Plaid – ‘New Bass Hippo’
  • Joubert Singers – ‘Stand on the word’ (Panoptikum Arkestra Remix)
  • Damiano Von Erckert – ‘All Good’
  • Daniel Grau – ‘Combination’ (Mark E Edit)
  • Baiser – ‘Summer Breeze’
  • Charli XCX – ‘You (Ha Ha Ha)’ (Lindstrøm Remix)

Ruf Dug

  • Motor City Drum Ensemble – ‘Lonely One’ [20:20 Vision]
  • Lugnet – ‘Rå Energi’
  • Eirwud Mudwasser – ‘Shivers’
  • Al Dobson Jr – ‘Santiago Black’ (Ptaki Remix)
  • Africane 808 – ‘Riddim Is All’ (Wolf Muller Breaks)
  • Pierre & Baptiste – ‘Virage’ (Ruf Dug Extension)
  • The Parachute Club – ‘Tobago Style’ (KBE Extension)
  • Ruf Dug – ‘Speedboat’ (Peaking Lights Disco Dub)
  • Dojoji – ‘Quincunx’
  • Jack J – ‘Atmosphere’
  • Samrai Ft Fox – ‘Let It Ride’
  • George Solar – ‘Come As InI’
  • Gnork – ‘One Point Two’
  • Legowelt – ‘Half Moon 106’
  • Omar-S – ‘Here’s Your Trance Now Dance’
  • Selvy – ‘Catamaran’
  • Moodymann – ‘Lake Shore Drive’ (Todd Terje Rekutt)
  • Al Dobson Jr – ‘Edit’
  • M&M – ‘Black Stations White Stations’ (Andi Hanley Edit)
